design_gotchas.title: Fixed 5.0 V Rail — Requires >= 6.5 V VIN (NEVER Swap Into 3.3 V LM1117IMPX-3.3 Sockets)
design_gotchas.detail: LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB (marking N06B) shares the identical SOT-223 package and pinout as LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (marking N05B) but outputs 5.0 V and requires VIN >= 6.5 V to stay out of dropout (1.2 V typ / 1.4 V max at 800 mA). Populating it on a 3.3 V MCU rail causes immediate overvoltage damage.

design_gotchas.title: Strict 0.3–22 Ω Output Capacitor ESR Window — Unstable With Bare MLCC Ceramic Caps
design_gotchas.detail: Like all bipolar/NPN-Darlington LM1117 variants, LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB requires >= 10 µF solid tantalum (or MLCC with 0.5–1 Ω series resistor) keeping ESR strictly inside 0.3 Ω to 22 Ω to prevent high-frequency loop oscillation.

design_gotchas.title: SOT-223 Thermal Tab Is Connected to VOUT (Pin 2) — Severe 12 V-to-5 V Thermal Derating
design_gotchas.detail: Tab is internally tied to 5.0 V VOUT (never ground it). Stepping 12 V down to 5.0 V at just 300 mA dissipates 2.1 W, exceeding SOT-223's 61.6 °C/W high-K budget (ΔT = 129°C) at room temperature — use a buck converter for high-VIN / high-current 5 V rails.

design_gotchas.title: High 5 mA Typ (15 mA Max) Quiescent Current & No Reverse-Current Protection
design_gotchas.detail: LM1117I-5.0 consumes 5 mA typ (up to 15 mA over -40°C to 125°C) even at zero load, making it unsuitable for battery-powered standby rails. Add a Schottky bypass diode from VOUT to VIN if COUT > 25 µF and VIN can short to ground.

typical_use_cases: Industrial 7 V–12 V to 5.0 V linear post-regulation for low-noise analog and sensor rails
Compact SOT-223 5.0 V rail generation in AC/DC power supplies and servo control boards
Legacy 5.0 V 800 mA point-of-load LDO where tantalum output capacitors are already populated
Wide-temperature (-40°C to +125°C) fixed 5 V auxiliary bias supplies below 250 mA continuous load
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM1117IMPX-5.0/NOPB is an industrial-grade (-40°C to +125°C TJ) fixed 5.0 V, 800 mA low-dropout linear regulator in a 3-lead + VOUT-tab SOT-223 (DCY) package. Operating from 6.5 V to 15 V (20 V abs max) with 1.2 V typical dropout at 800 mA, ±1% initial accuracy (±4% over temperature), and 75 dB PSRR at 120 Hz, it serves as a rugged 5.0 V rail generator in mains-powered industrial systems. Designers must strictly enforce its 0.3–22 Ω output capacitor ESR window (minimum 10 µF tantalum), verify SOT-223 thermal dissipation (RθJA = 61.6 °C/W), and never confuse it with 3.3 V or ADJ SOT-223 variants.

audit_notes: Vision-verified DCY SOT-223 Top View on 300 DPI PNG page 3 (Figure 6-1 & Table 6-1): Pin 1 = ADJ/GND, Pin 2 = VOUT (Tab = VOUT), Pin 3 = VIN.

Verified Absolute Maximum Ratings (20 V VIN, 150°C TJ), Recommended Conditions (15 V max, -40 to 125°C TJ for LM1117I), and DCY Thermal Info (RθJA = 61.6 °C/W, RθJC(top) = 42.5 °C/W) on 300 DPI PNG page 4.

Verified Section 7.6 LM1117I-5.0 specs on 300 DPI PNG pages 7-8: VOUT = 5.0 V (±1% at 25°C, ±4% over temp), VIN min = 6.5 V, dropout = 1.2 V typ (1.4 V max) at 800 mA, IQ = 5 mA typ (15 mA max), PSRR = 75 dB, noise = 0.003% of 5 V = 150 µVRMS.
